ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle ACB=90^\circ$, $AC=3$, and $AB=5$, what is the value of $\sin B$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} In the right-angled triangle $ABC$, $\angle C=90^\circ$, $AC=3$, $AB=5$, \\
$\therefore$ $\sin B=\frac{AC}{AB}=\boxed{\frac{3}{5}}$.
